NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE OBJECT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the

National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of

National Heritage) (Heritage Object) (No. 2) Order 2026.

National Heritage

2. The objects specified in columns (1) and (2) of the Schedule that have been

declared as heritage objects as published in the Gazette specified in column (3)

and listed in the Register are declared to be National Heritage.

SCHEDULE

(1) (2) (3)

Category Object Gazette

1. Staple Food (a) Burasak P.U. (B) 66/2024

(b) Mi Kolok
